SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as web_sales_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
  AND (f.channel_code = 'WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2, 3))
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  f.channel_code,
  f.channel_id,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as total_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code, f.channel_id
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code, f.channel_id

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  MIN(f.gross_amount) as min_line,
  MAX(f.gross_amount) as max_line,
  AVG(f.gross_amount) as avg_line,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as total
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) as return_count,
  SUM(r.refund_gross) as total_refunded
FROM fact_return_line r
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
